'''David Maneiro''' (born 17 February 1989) is an Andorran international [[Association football|footballer]] who plays for [[UE Santa Coloma]], as a [[defender (association football)|defender]].

==Career==
He has played club football for [[FC Andorra]] and [[UE Santa Coloma]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=33948|accessdate=11 October 2014}}</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2009.<ref name = "NFT"/>
